dataset_title: Pedestrian Counting System - Monthly (counts per hour)

admission_evidence.completeness_rule: All pages match total_count; retains sensor-hour granularity without backfilling missing minute readings

notes: The dataset description says monthly updates while its quality metadata says daily; daily checks do not imply a guaranteed publication cadence. Ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving hours cannot be assigned a UTC timestamp from sensing_date and hourday alone.

invariants.granularity_rule: Preserves sensor-hour granularity; must not synthesize or backfill missing minute counts
invariants.no_zero_filling_rule: Missing sensor-hour intervals are unobserved, never zero-filled
invariants.timezone_rule: sensing_date and hourday reflect Australia/Melbourne local time and are converted to UTC timestamp
